notes.title: Great offer and trial demo
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167777/3ea3b05d94ef538d39a339d432668d1672274096.png[/img]
We are celebrating the approaching first anniversary (this April 9th) by joining the Steam discounts with a great offer. We have also been preparing a playable demo for all those who want to try the project before deciding to buy it.

Personally, I can't believe it's already been a year since I published it, but at the same time I can hardly remember the time when I was developing the game. In this year there have been many changes between the game and I have learned many, many things about how to run and how to sell a videogame. 

I hope that those of you who have never tried it can take a look at the game and enjoy it.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
To celebrate that the game is going to be one year old in April I'm going to make a sale on the game that will last all that month. Additionally I am preparing a demo of the game so that people who don't decide to buy the game can try it for free. 

Patch notes:

-Fixed a couple of graphical bugs that happened to some players.

-Several spelling errors have been revised including the error in the start menu.

-Fixed the bug that showed some Spanish texts in the English version in a certain path of the game.

-The color balance of some illustrations has been corrected.

Best regards

notes.title: Super Update 2023
notes.notes:
[h1]New major update for Dear Althea!!![/h1]
The biggest one to date that fixes many of the detected bugs and improves the experience in the game menus.

Before looking at the details, remember that a new project is already in development and you can add it to your wishlist: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309720/From_the_Streets_to_the_Script__A_Carabanchel_Story/?beta=0]From the Streets to the Script - A Carabanchel Story.[/url]
(More info at the end)

[h2]Update details:[/h2]
Engine update: The game has been updated to the latest version of the "Visual Novel Maker" software.

[h2]Menu improvements: [/h2]
-The main menu now displays more information while the layout and design of the buttons has been improved. Also the game logo has been added with a short animation that I hope you like.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167777/f907057c927aeeeece02597e667304cb1d36c310.png[/img]

-As I have been asked so much, I have added a diagram showing the different branches of the chapters in chronological order. Remember that there are chapters that change radically according to the decisions you make; a good example is the "Aerated Bread Company" chapter. Remember also that decisions to get to each chapter may depend on decisions made in chapters prior to the chapter where the story forks.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167777/2da800da8fb8c8a28c05090e4b8df6249f8503ae.png[/img]

-The "Haking" menu has been changed and is now called "Chapters". The interface has also been changed and now displays a nicer layout with illustrations of key moments and the general interface. Additionally, some bugs have been fixed thanks to Nox Noctis and a new button has been added to go to the menu showing chapter branching.
-The "more" menu is now called "Extras" and the layout has been improved. Unnecessary information has been removed and buttons have been simplified. Credit titles are now easier to access and do not generate strange errors. 


[h1]Corrections:[/h1]
-Correction of spelling errors: Thanks to Nox Noctis for his great, thorough and really professional help with correcting spelling errors in English. Among others the correction of "Wrong pronouns". Thanks to his great work searching and correcting, plus the help of other players who have also contributed, now the game has improved the quality of its texts.
-Correction of several visual bugs that some users were experiencing.
-Correction of the images that did not appear on the screen when the scene arrived leaving the previous image on the screen.
-Correction of the names and faces that appeared incorrectly in some dialogues.
-Correction of texts that appeared in the incorrect language.
-Corrections in the results of several puzzles.
-Correction of several layout errors in the "superficial character analysis".
-Correction of repeated phrases in "superficial character analysis".
-Fixed some errors that occurred with a specific combination of decisions.


[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309720/From_the_Streets_to_the_Script__A_Carabanchel_Story/?beta=0]NEW GAME![/url][/h2]
"Create your character and experience a fun story in which you will meet friends, enemies and partners as you try to carry out a vital project with your friends: to create an anime before you finish your studies."

[previewyoutube=HWz4HpYYsMo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] I'm very excited to announce this new project I'm working on. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309720/From_the_Streets_to_the_Script__A_Carabanchel_Story/?beta=0]From the Streets to the Script - A Carabanchel Story[/url] will be a fully animated visual novel that you will love. Visit the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2309720/From_the_Streets_to_the_Script__A_Carabanchel_Story/?beta=0]Steam[/url] or [url=https://tijerinart.itch.io/from-the-streets-to-the-script-a-carabanchel-story]itch.io[/url] page to see all the details!
This project has been in development at the same time as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2058230/The_Evil_Furry/]"The evil furry"[/url], but I've decided to stop the development of the latter for the moment as it's a much more commercially risky project, so don't hesitate to subscribe so you don't miss any related news!

I hope you like this news and thank you for your time.

notes.title: Nominations for the Steam Awards 2022 are coming up!
notes.notes:
Nominations for the Steam Awards 2022 are coming up!
Since its release on the 9th of April this year "Dear Althea" has been praised in its reviews for the visuals of the project. If you also liked the 780 illustrations made with special care to show every detail of the story; consider giving the award "Outstanding visual style" to Dear Althea at the Steam Awards 2022!!!!

notes.title: Update version day 17-4-2022
notes.notes:
Hello, one more day I bring here the summary of the new update of the Dear Althea videogame starting with a new feature I have been working on; you will now be able to save at the beginning of the chapter. This will make it possible to have a save for each chapter making replayability easier. 

A beta has been opened to test the Linux version at Ithc.io for free. If you try it, please be aware that it is very likely that you will experience some kind of bug or even not be able to start the game. I would appreciate if you could write me comments about your experience with this version.

I have started to put the date in the update file so that everyone can easily check which update they have received. 

[olist]
[*] Finally here is the list of bugs and errors fixed:
[*] Small translation errors in English.  
[*] Small spelling errors in Spanish. 
[*] Error in the portraits of characters with Drake's name. 
[*] Error that in some cases caused Eliza to leave the house, even if you decided not to. 
[*] Small sound error in strange cases. 
[*] Depending on the decisions made in the "Friends of the Settlement" chapter, a loop would occur. 
[*] Bugfix inside the Haker menu
[/olist]

notes.title: Major update - Bug fixes - New Haker Menu!!!
notes.notes:
This is one of the biggest updates there has been and probably will be from Dear Althea. It fixes almost all the bugs and errors that have been detected to date, but there is also a new feature that will greatly speed up replayability. The Haker!!! option has been added to the main menu. From which you can go to any chapter and even change any decision to see the result. It's still in testing phase and it's possible that when you indicate a game from the main menu, it may cause unexpected problems. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40167777/fabeb9ccfcddd3363838f6b4e66e4e345b82da55.png[/img]
That said, here is the list of fixed bugs, most of them detected by @Bahaha:

Small translation errors in English.  
Redundancy in some sentences in the English translation. 
Bug that caused Faustina to always be inside the library even if Althea didn't invite her in. 
Loops that happened when you had a strong argument with Faustina. 
Bug in the symbols of the locks in the decision of the chapter "Miss Cressida Delafield Lanington". 
Flower circle animation appeared in some moments when it was not supposed to be there. 
Some spelling mistakes related to the apostrophe. 
The word "ejaculation" has been replaced by other words despite being written by the original author; e.g.:  
...setting down his teacup, and casting an eye irrepressibly jovial even while uttering this pensive ejaculation along the emptied bookshelves.  (page 54 - Dear Faustina)  
...pouring himself a cup of tea, and casting an eye along the empty bookshelves.   
Various bugs that made Miss Delafield look as Mr Drake was talking 
Some occasional "Spanglish" error in decision making. 
Missing phrase from the "good news" chapter 
Error that, depending on the choices made, prevented continuing from the women's club party. 

Finally, thanks to the work of @Bahaha I can tell you that in order to find your Dear Althea savegames in your Windows you have to:

notes.title: Update day 2 - fix major bugs
notes.notes:
I apologize to those who have suffered bugs while playing Dear Althea, and I am very grateful to all those who have told me about the bugs they have encountered during their game; being only one person, these bugs had gone unnoticed until now. 
I hope that with this update, the most common bugs that you have reported to me will be fixed or at least less annoying.

[b]To enjoy these changes, be sure to re-download the game to get the April 10th version.
[/b]
Before talking about the new features that this new version brings, I have to remind you that, because the game engine is Visual Novel Maker, there are some limitations that prevent me from implementing: auto-save, the game remembering the language settings or the errors produced when you click too fast the right mouse button.

That said, here are the notes on this new version:
[olist]
[*] A button has been added at the bottom right to skip the introduction videos. 
[*] Fixed, in most cases, the bug that made the background of the text disappear and made the text unreadable when the scene was very dark.
[*] Added a shadow to the text to improve visibility and alleviate the bug that causes the background of the text to disappear (which usually appeared or appears in some cases when the right mouse button is clicked too quickly).
[*] The puzzle, which consisted of a box with a family represented on the lid, has been removed for the time being, as the source of the bug, which in some cases did not allow the game to continue, was not found. I will incorporate the puzzle again later if I am able to find the cause of the bug, but I'm afraid it has to do with the engine used to create the game.
[*] The speed at which text appears has been accelerated.
[*] Fixed most of the text that sometimes repeated due to a bug.
[/olist]

I would like to thank again the comments with the bug reports, thanks to them this game is better and I hope that more people are encouraged to put their comments and opinions to continue improving the product as much as possible.

Best regards and thanks for your attention.
Tijerín Art Studios
